notes.title: Episode 05 Devlog
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584495/6f0864eaed676502e07fca62fa0b33c1625332f6.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It's finally time for Episode 05! With it we're bringing a series of additions to the game, including more X-Ray options, an animated holocall, new status notifications and more![/p][p] [/p][p]If you are interested in an early peek at the current state of the game, you can do so via our website: [url="https://AziendaGames.com"]AziendaGames.com[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]For all of you who decide to give it a play, we hope you'll like the update and thank you so much for your support![/p][p][/p][p]Here is the teaser trailer for the new episode:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0Uy0eKf0NHI"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Falling Undercover: Nox Syndicate - Episode 05[/h2][p][/p][p]Here is an overview of the new content:[/p][list][*][p]5 New CGs[/p][/*][*][p]5 New Animations (130+ variations)[/p][/*][*][p]2 Sprite Variations[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Art (1)[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced 4 BGs with new handmade ones[/p][/*][*][p]25k words[/p][/*][*][p]107 Additional SFX[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As you can see, this update has the usual complement of story updates and CGs, but more than anything is jam-packed full of animation variations. An absolute ton. More than twice the number of last month![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]In addition to that, we’ve introduced a few quality of life updates we figured we’d bring to your attention:[/p][list][*][p]You can now change the size of the X-Ray window by pressing the “X-ray Size” button on the shortcut bar or by pressing the “C” key on PC.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now press the “Z” key on PC versions to open up the Status menu.[/p][/*][*][p]You now get real time status notifications for changes to numerical values (so you won’t have to go to the menu to see if there has been an increase to the number of blowjobs Luna has given if you don’t want to).[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]On top of all that, we’ve added some additional capability to the X-Ray visuals which you will get to enjoy as we roll out over the next few episodes! We hope you'll enjoy![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]That’s it for us today. Please take care and have a good September! 💜[/p][p align="start"]Azienda[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Episode 04 Devlog
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584495/b3a3e401d7c1ef4e743f0e9fa894083be766ccd1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p]We're happy to bring you Episode 04 of FUNS, with a new feature: An upgraded, interactive [b]X-Ray Vision[/b]![/p][p]If you are interested in an early peek at the current state of the game, you can do so via our website:[/p][p][url="https://AziendaGames.com"]AziendaGames.com[/url]![/p][p][/p][p]For all of you who decide to give it a play, we hope you'll like the update and thank you so much for your support![/p][p][/p][p]Here is the teaser trailer for the new episode:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4oNch4fXBJI"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]Falling Undercover: Nox Syndicate - Episode 04[/h2][p][/p][p]Episode 04 continues the main story and adds more scenes, artwork, music, sounds and more. Here is an overview of the new content:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]6 New CGs[/p][/*][*][p]3 New Animations[/p][/*][*][p]Interactive X-Ray Vision system[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Art (1)[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced 3 BGs with new handmade ones[/p][/*][*][p]24k words[/p][/*][*][p]125 Additional SFX[/p][/*][*][p]Added Chinese translation for Episode 02[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The episode took us longer than expected due to the aforementioned new feature we added: [b]A live and interactive X-Ray Vision system![/b][/p][p]This was a very ambitious project that required time, resources and more playtesting than usual. Ren'Py isn't quite made for it, so we had to make it work. Things got a bit stressful, but we kept going and we hope that you'll like the result. Speaking of it, here is how the new feature works:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]New X-Ray Vision:[/b][/p][p]The old X-Ray view was always a static picture that could only be accessed in the status screen, but now we changed it so it can actually be animated - and you can toggle the X-Ray view on and off at any time! (Minus the occasional technical exception).[/p][p]As you can imagine, this feature will be very useful for future scenes[/p][p] [/p][p][b]How to:[/b][/p][p]To enable the X-Ray view: On PC you can press the X key to toggle it on and off, or click the X-Ray button on the quick bar at the bottom of the dialogue box (tapping that button is also how you access the X-Ray view on mobile).[/p][p]The X-Ray panel can be moved around by clicking and holding the mouse (or by touching and dragging with your finger on mobile). Please enjoy the freedom of placing it wherever you desire![/p][p]The X-Ray feature is available in both POVs as long as you are playing with the Full Status or Limited Status mode enabled. Even when you are playing as Aiden, you can toggle the X-Ray view to get an intimate insight of Luna’s most private parts at that very moment.[/p][p]We also made a change for those who play in Limited Status mode. By default, the X-Ray will be disabled in the Status menu, but now you can activate it by clicking the button right above it. We hope this will make the experience even more personalized for players.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Important:[/b] We had to make lots of changes to the code to make the X-Ray Vision work, as such your earlier saves won’t work properly. We apologize for the inconvenience. 🙏 If you don’t want to start fresh and just want to jump to the latest content, you can do so via the Episode Select feature in the Main Menu (you will be asked to pick your perspective and previous choices).[/p][p][/p][p]That’s it for now! We’re already at work on the next episode, so please look forward to it! (After enjoying Episode 04, of course!)[/p][p][/p][p]Take care. 💜[/p][p]Azienda[/p]

notes.title: Episode 03 Devlog
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584495/cff72bc07ae0c097a92ef2f4854cb72e68eb098c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]The day that we have been working for is finally here! Episode 03 is out now! If you are interested in an early peek at the game, you can do so via our website: [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Faziendagames.com%2F"]https://aziendagames.com/[/url] Thank you for your support! 💜[/p][p][/p][p]Without further ado, here is the teaser trailer for the new episode:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="SHEifXsctTI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Falling Undercover: Nox Syndicate - Episode 03[/h2][p][/p][p]This one is a big update. Bigger than we initially planned, that’s for sure! It adds the following to the game:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]5 New CGs[/p][/*][*][p]5 New Animations[/p][/*][*][p]4 New Sprite Variations[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Art (2)[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced 5 BGs with new handmade ones[/p][/*][*][p]25k words[/p][/*][*][p]127 Additional SFX[/p][/*][*][p]Added Chinese translation for Episode 01[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]As you can see, starting with this update, we will be adding a Chinese translation to FUNS as we proceed from episode to episode. Currently, Episode 01 is available in Chinese in addition to English and we hope to add more episodes monthly for our overseas fans![/p][p]But, of course, there is plenty of new content for our English readers. More than ever, really! Five CGs animated, new character sprites and more… We really hope you enjoy it all 😋[/p][p][/p][p][b]Important Note:[/b][/p][p]Important for everyone playing early: Due to some of the changes we made to the code, some of your earlier saves won’t work properly. We apologize for the inconvenience, but in order to alleviate the situation we have improved the episode selection menu. It should be much easier to use than the iteration from our last game, [i]Turning the Page[/i]. If you want to jump to the latest content, go on over to Episode 03 on the second page of the Episode select menu, pick your perspective and dive right in.[/p][p][/p][p]And for those of you who haven’t yet given the game an early try, don’t worry! Episode 01 and 02 are now available for free on our website: [url="https://aziendagames.com/"]https://aziendagames.com/[/url][/p][p][/p][p]That’s everything for now! 🙏[/p][p]You all take care until next time! 💜[/p][p][/p][p]Azienda[/p]

notes.title: Episode 02 Devlog
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45584495/a85cebcf586f1caa09277b3663cac0885f6faadc.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

It’s time! We’ve finished scripting, drawing, programming and testing Episode 02 of FUNS. It’s all done and ready for you to sink your teeth into if you decide to support us for an early look on [url=https://aziendagames.com/]https://aziendagames.com/[/url] 💜

It’s a big one too. Now that our story and the setting of Neo Elysia have been set up, we can start to dig into the real meat of the story. A story of light, hope, and chaste romance… or maybe a slightly different story of darkness, corruption, and cheating. Who’s to say?! 😌

Judge for yourself!

[previewyoutube=m7yYmcnZjOQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Falling Undercover: Nox Syndicate - [Episode 02][/h2]

This episode clocks in at slightly longer than the first update and is packed with some spicy new art and animations. You aren’t going to want to miss it! We also added another scene from Luna’s POV back in Episode 01, to help you to get to know her a bit better before the fun gets started. Anyway, enough about that, here’s a full breakdown of what’s included in Episode 02:

[list]
[*] 5 New CGs
[*] 3 New Animations
[*] 1 New Sprite Variation
[*] Additional Art (4)
[*] 4 New Handmade BGs
[*] 24k words
[*] 160 Additional SFX
[*] Replaced Episode 01 animations with remastered versions that run at 60 fps
[/list]
And for those of you who haven’t had a chance to experience the first episode, we got you covered. Check it out right now, entirely for free, also on our website:

[url=https://aziendagames.com/]https://aziendagames.com/[/url] 

That’s it from us for now, we get straight to work on Episode 03!

Until then, take care 💜
Azienda
